about: MasterWorld's sounds and music. `node vendor/assetgenerator/packages/audio/tools/make.mjs --spec tools/sound/sounds.json --out public/sound --raw /mnt/project-files/masterworld/audio/raw` turns this into public/sound (see tools/sound/README.md). Seed Audio speaks a prompt unless it starts with 'The sound of'. `from` reuses takes of Arnd's other games, kept in the raw folder.
